page_text_ocr_zh:
兔子先生和兔子太太住在蒲公英小镇里。兔子太太
最近似乎长胖了不少，她好像一直在不停地吃东西。
page_text_en:
Mr. Rabbit and Mrs. Rabbit live in Dandelion Town. Mrs. Rabbit
seems to have put on quite a bit of weight recently. She appears to be eating nonstop.
summary_zh: 兔子先生和兔子太太住在蒲公英小镇，兔子太太最近似乎长胖了不少，一直在不停地吃东西。

title_zh: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民
title_en: Understanding Long and Short, Tall and Short: The Mysterious New Resident

page_text_ocr_zh:
兔子先生看起来毫不在意，他甚至想去长颈鹿面包店，给兔子太太订一个长长的胡萝卜面包。想象一下：如果那个面包被拿回来，它会不会从兔子先生家的烟囱里伸出来呢？

兔子先生真的去长颈鹿面包店订长长的胡萝卜面包了。长颈鹿打算给兔子先生现烤一个。
page_text_en:
Mr. Rabbit didn't seem to care at all. He even thought about going to the giraffe bakery to order a long carrot bread for Mrs. Rabbit. Imagine: if that bread were brought back, would it stick out of Mr. Rabbit's chimney?

Mr. Rabbit really went to the giraffe bakery to order a long carrot bread. The giraffe planned to bake one fresh for Mr. Rabbit.
summary_zh: 兔子先生决定为太太去长颈鹿面包店订一个长长的胡萝卜面包，并想象面包可能从烟囱伸出的有趣情景。画面中，兔子先生站在面包店前，长颈鹿厨师从窗户探出头来。

title_zh: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民
title_en: Understanding Long and Short, Tall and Short: The Mysterious New Resident
source_file: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
在等待的时间里，
兔子先生告诉长颈鹿：
“我们蒲公英小镇要有
新居民了。”
长颈鹿实在太高了，
矮小的兔子先生要拼命
仰起头，才能看到长颈鹿的眼睛。

长颈鹿弯下长长的脖子：“我们的新居民长得可爱吗？”
“长得像天使一样可爱。”兔子先生微笑着，他的嘴角似乎要流出甜
甜的蜜来。
“这真是个好消息！”长颈鹿说，“真希望我们的新居民没有我这
样长长的脖子。有时候长脖子真是一件很麻烦的事情，我和顾客交谈就很
不方便。”
“如你所愿，新居民的脖子和我一样短。”

长长的面包烤好了。不过，面
包太长了，兔子先生只好把它扛在
肩上。
page_text_en:
While waiting,
Mr. Rabbit told the giraffe:
"Our蒲公英小镇 is getting a new resident."
The giraffe was too tall,
and the short Mr. Rabbit had to strain his neck
upward to see the giraffe's eyes.

The giraffe bent down its long neck: "Is our new resident cute?"
"As cute as an angel," Mr. Rabbit smiled, his lips seeming to drip with sweet
honey.
"That's wonderful news!" said the giraffe. "I really hope our new resident doesn't have a neck as long as mine. Sometimes, a long neck is such a nuisance; it's very inconvenient for me to talk with customers."
"As you wish, the new resident's neck is as short as mine."

The long bread was baked. However, the
bread was too long, so Mr. Rabbit had to carry it on his shoulder.
summary_zh: 兔子先生在长颈鹿面包店等待时，告诉长颈鹿蒲公英小镇将有新居民。长颈鹿希望新居民的脖子不要太长，兔子先生则幽默地回应新居民的脖子和自己一样短。最后，兔子先生扛着烤好的长长面包离开。

title_zh: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民
title_en: Understanding Long and Short, Tall and Short: The Mysterious New Resident

page_text_ocr_zh:
路过猴先生的水果店时，
兔子先生看到了新鲜的草莓。
想到兔子太太可喜欢吃酸酸甜甜的草莓了，兔子先生就让猴先生给他称一些。

在等待的时间里，兔子先生告诉猴先生：“我们蒲公英小镇要有新居民了。”
猴先生摆了摆长长的尾巴：“我们的新居民会唱歌吗？”
“就像百灵鸟唱歌一样好听。”兔子先生微笑着，他的嘴角似乎要流出甜甜的蜜来。
“这真是个好消息！”猴先生说，“真希望我们的新居民没有我这种长长的尾巴。它经常会惹麻烦——天哪，就像这样！”
猴先生长长的尾巴不小心碰翻了装桃子的水果篮，桃子骨碌碌滚了一地。
“如你所愿，新居民的尾巴和我一样短。”
page_text_en:
Passing by Mr. Monkey's fruit shop,
Mr. Rabbit saw fresh strawberries.
Thinking how much Mrs. Rabbit loved sour-sweet strawberries, Mr. Rabbit asked Mr. Monkey to weigh some for him.

While waiting, Mr. Rabbit told Mr. Monkey, "Our蒲公英小镇 is getting new residents!"
Mr. Monkey flicked his long tail: "Will our new resident be able to sing?"
"As beautifully as a lark," Mr. Rabbit smiled, his mouth seeming to drip with sweet honey.
"That's wonderful news!" Mr. Monkey said, "I really hope our new resident doesn't have a tail as long as mine. It often causes trouble—oh, like this!"
Mr. Monkey's long tail accidentally knocked over the basket of peaches, and the peaches rolled all over the ground.
"As you wish, the new resident's tail will be as short as mine."
summary_zh: 兔子先生在等待面包时路过猴先生的水果店，买了草莓，并告诉猴先生蒲公英小镇将有新居民。猴先生希望新居民没有自己长长的尾巴，因为尾巴常惹麻烦，不小心碰翻了桃子篮，兔子先生幽默回应新居民的尾巴会和自己一样短。

title_zh: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民

page_text_ocr_zh:
草莓称好了，兔子先生把肩上的面包往后挪了挪，提着草莓就走了。经过棕熊鞋店的时候，他突然想起：得给自己买一双好走路的运动鞋。
兔子先生看中了两双运动鞋，它们都摆放在比他高的那排柜子上。矮小的兔子先生够不着。高大的棕熊把鞋子从高高的柜子上拿下来，让兔子先生挑选。

试穿鞋子的时候，兔子先生告诉棕熊：“我们蒲公英小镇要有新居民了。”
棕熊抬起大大的脚跳了两个舞步：“我们的新居民会跳舞吗？”
“像白天鹅跳舞一样好看。”兔子先生微笑着，他的嘴角似乎要流出甜甜的蜜来。
“这真是个好消息。”棕熊说，“真希望我们的新居民不要长得像我这么高大。长得高大，每天要吃很多食物，有时候这真是麻烦的事情。”
“如你所愿，新居民会长得和我一样矮小。”
page_text_en:
The strawberries were weighed. Mr. Rabbit shifted the loaf of bread on his shoulder, picked up the strawberries, and walked away. As he passed the bear's shoe store, he suddenly remembered: he needed to buy a good pair of sneakers for walking.
Mr. Rabbit spotted two pairs of sneakers, both placed on a shelf higher than he was. The small Mr. Rabbit couldn't reach them. The tall bear took the shoes down from the high shelf for Mr. Rabbit to choose from.

While trying on the shoes, Mr. Rabbit told the bear, "Our蒲公英 town is getting new residents!"
The bear lifted his big feet and danced two steps. "Will our new residents dance?"
"As beautifully as a swan," Mr. Rabbit smiled, his lips seeming to drip with sweet honey.
"That's wonderful news," the bear said. "I really hope our new residents won't be as tall as me. Being tall means eating a lot every day, and sometimes that's really troublesome."
"As you wish, the new residents will be as short as I am."
summary_zh: 兔子先生在棕熊鞋店买运动鞋时，向棕熊透露蒲公英小镇将有新居民。棕熊希望新居民不要像自己一样高大，因为高大需要吃很多食物，很麻烦，兔子先生则幽默地保证新居民会和自己一样矮小。

title_zh: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民
title_en: Understanding Long and Short, Tall and Short: The Mysterious New Resident

page_text_ocr_zh:
兔子先生穿上新买的运动鞋，把肩上的面包往后挪了挪，提着草莓，快乐地走在回家的路上。
快到家门口的时候——
“兔子先生，兔子先生……”
是三只小猴子，他们是猴先生的孩子，他们想知道新居民是谁。
“你们猜猜看。”兔子先生微笑着，把肩上的面包往后挪了挪。
“新居民的脖子跟你的一样短，
尾巴也跟你一样短，长得也跟你一样矮……”三只小猴子想不出来。
page_text_en:
Mr. Rabbit put on his new running shoes, shifted the bread on his shoulder, carried the strawberries, and happily walked home.
Just as he was approaching his front door——
"Mr. Rabbit, Mr. Rabbit..."
They were three little monkeys, the children of Mr. Monkey. They wanted to know who the new resident was.
"Guess who it is," Mr. Rabbit smiled, shifting the bread on his shoulder.
"The new resident's neck is as short as yours,
their tail is as short as yours, and they're as short as you..." The three little monkeys couldn't figure it out.
summary_zh: 兔子先生扛着长长的面包、提着草莓走在回家路上，快到家门口时，三只小猴子拦住他，好奇地询问新居民是谁，兔子先生笑着提示新居民和自己一样短小，但小猴子们仍猜不出来。

title_zh: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民
title_en: Understanding Long and Short, Tall and Short: The Mysterious New Resident
source_file: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民（5-8岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
新居民到底是谁？真神秘呀！
兔子先生说答案在他的家里。
到家啦！兔子太太挺着大肚子，已经在门口等着他了。

“亲爱的，你回来了！”兔子太太抱了抱兔子先生。
“兔子太太，你的肚子真大。”三只小猴子好奇地看着兔子太太的大肚子。
“是的，因为里面有我们的小宝宝呀。”兔子太太的嘴角似乎要流出甜甜的蜜来。
原来是这样啊！肚子里的小宝宝就是蒲公英小镇的新居民。
page_text_en:
Who is the new resident? So mysterious!
Mr. Rabbit said the answer is in his home.
Home at last! Mrs. Rabbit, with her big belly, was already waiting for him at the door.

"Darling, you're back!" Mrs. Rabbit hugged Mr. Rabbit.
"Mrs. Rabbit, your belly is so big." The three little monkeys looked curiously at Mrs. Rabbit's big belly.
"Yes, because our little baby is inside." Mrs. Rabbit's smile seemed to drip with sweet honey.
So that's how it is! The baby in her belly is the new resident of Dandelion Town.
summary_zh: 兔子先生回到家，发现太太挺着大肚子在门口等他。三只小猴子好奇地询问，兔子太太揭晓谜底：肚子里的小宝宝就是蒲公英小镇的新居民。

title_zh: 了解长短高矮：神秘的新居民
title_en: Understanding Long and Short, Tall and Short: The Mysterious New Resident

page_text_ocr_zh:
“亲爱的，这是我给你买的长长的胡萝卜面包。”兔子先生把面包从肩上拿下来——
呀，长长的面包怎么变成短短的面包了？
三只小猴子知道为什么吗？
“哈哈哈，我们走了，
兔子先生！”
page_text_en:
"Dear, this is the long carrot bread I bought for you." Mr. Rabbit takes the bread off his shoulder—
Oh, how did the long bread become a short one?
Do the three little monkeys know why?
"Hahaha, we're off, Mr. Rabbit!"
summary_zh: 兔子先生回家后，将长长的面包递给太太，面包却变短了，三只小猴子在一旁好奇地询问原因，随后笑着离开。

请比较下面的几组物品，在更长物品的后面贴上一个“√”。
page_text_en:
According to height, please arrange Mr. Rabbit, the giraffe, Mr. Monkey, and Mr. Bear in order, and say who is the tallest and who is the shortest. Find the number stickers 1, 2, 3, 4, and stick them on the corresponding animals in order of height.

Please compare the following groups of items, and put a “√” behind the longer item.
summary_zh: 本页为互动练习页，左侧要求根据高矮给兔子先生、长颈鹿、猴先生和棕熊排序，右侧要求比较几组物品的长短并在较长者后打勾。
